name: Spell Bluff [Teamwork]
body:
When you are in the area of effect of an ally’s harmful spell, your foes are caught off guard.

Benefit(s): When you fail your saving throw (including voluntarily failing the save) against an ally’s spell that would harm you with an area of effect that includes you, intelligent enemies within the spell’s area take a –2 penalty on their saving throws to resist the spell’s effects.
